subdivisions.name: Desert Wilderness Ranches
subdivisions.notes: Recorded as a SUR MAP, not a PLAT MAP. 4-sheet survey of ~40-acre parcels in Secs 13, 14 and 19 T1S R7-8W; easement table: 60-ft ingress/egress + PUE per the survey, 30-ft ROW easement per Book 360 Pg 18, 20-ft roadway easements per Doc 94-252315–252320, electric-line easements per dockets. No BSL/zoning chart — MCZO base-district standards control.
subdivisions.easements: 60 ft ingress/egress and public utility easement (per survey); 30 ft right-of-way easement (Book 360 Pg 18); 20 ft roadway easements (Docs 94-252315 to 94-252320); electric-line easements per recorded dockets.
